limitations: These PDFs close the visual-source gap for Al-Bazzi, Qunbul and Al-Susi, but they are not byte-identical official KFQC downloads. Page mapping is documented per source and every candidate crop must retain this limitation.

bazzi-kfqc.pageMapping: The 604-page file begins with Al-Fatihah on PDF page 1 and Al-Baqarah on page 2; canonical Hafs page and PDF page are equal.

qunbul-kfqc.pageMapping: The 604-page file begins with Al-Fatihah on PDF page 1 and Al-Baqarah on page 2; canonical Hafs page and PDF page are equal.
qunbul-kfqc.license: Wikimedia Commons marks the file as public domain; uploader author information is missing.

sousi-kfqc.pageMapping: Two cover/title leaves precede the numbered 604-page Mushaf: canonical page 1 is PDF page 3. IslamHouse attributes this edition to the King Fahd Complex.
